items.title: Eric Schmitt's Jack Smith "perjury" gotcha has the wrong team
items.summary: At Jack Smith's Senate hearing, Sen. Eric Schmitt held up a poster board claiming Smith had gone to an Atlanta Hawks game to collude with Fani Willis and declared he had caught him committing perjury. Smith said he had been at an Iowa Hawkeyes game in Maryland: "You have the teams wrong sir." Jack Smith, Schmitt and the Atlanta Hawks all trended, a photo of Smith smirking ("The moment Jack Smith realized Eric Schmitt was talking about the wrong game") got 39K likes, and influencers who had pre-written "perjury" posts deleted them.
items.author: @sahilkapur

post.name: Sahil Kapur
post.text:
A phenomenal moment in the Senate.

Eric Schmitt, R-Mo., claims he has evidence Jack Smith went to a HAWKS game in Atlanta.

Smith denies it.

Schmitt declares he has busted Jack Smith for perjury.

Smith, vexed, says he went to HAWKEYES game in Maryland.
